edge.title: Replace NorMuon direction with KL-SOAP; keep hyperball and #8 setup
edge.summary: The hidden-matrix direction switches from NorMuon (momentum → Newton–Schulz → row normalization) to KL-SOAP: gradients are rotated into an eigenbasis Q_L, Q_R, Adam moments (beta1 0.95, beta2 0.9, eps 1e-8, no bias correction) are run there, and m/(√v+eps) is rotated back. The basis comes from KL-Shampoo factor EMAs (shampoo_beta 0.9) in which each side's gradient covariance is whitened by the other side's running inverse eigenvalues (L ← 0.9L + 0.1·G R⁻¹Gᵀ/cols), refreshed every step by one power-iteration + QR. The result still goes through #8's hyperball step at lr 0.018 with #8's init, per-shape optimizer split, linear schedules and aux AdamW; train_steps drops to 3125 with no early stop.

changes.label: KL-SOAP direction replaces NorMuon
changes.detail: klsoap_direction: G' = Q_Lᵀ G Q_R; exp_avg ← 0.95·exp_avg + 0.05·G'; exp_avg_sq ← 0.9·exp_avg_sq + 0.1·G'²; U = Q_L·(exp_avg/(√exp_avg_sq + 1e-8))·Q_Rᵀ, using the basis from the previous step. No momentum/NS/row normalization remains.

changes.label: KL-Shampoo factors + eigenvalue EMAs
changes.detail: update_2d_klsoap_preconditioner_: GG_L ← 0.9·GG_L + 0.1·G R̂⁻¹Gᵀ/cols and GG_R ← 0.9·GG_R + 0.1·Gᵀ L̂⁻¹G/rows, where R̂⁻¹, L̂⁻¹ = Q diag(eigen_sqrt_inv²) Qᵀ and eigen_sqrt_inv (≤ 4000) tracks EMAs of whitened projected-gradient diagonals.

changes.label: Per-step basis refresh
changes.detail: precondition_frequency = 1: refresh_klsoap_basis_ sets Q ← QR(GG·Q) on both sides every step and re-expresses exp_avg in the new basis (exp_avg_sq is not rotated).

changes.label: Init-only first optimizer step
changes.detail: The first step() per matrix only builds GG = G Gᵀ/cols, Gᵀ G/rows, Q = eigh eigenvectors (descending) and eigenvalue estimates 0.1 (init_factor), then skips the weight update.

changes.label: Steps 3275→3125, no early stop
changes.detail: train_steps = 3125, and the claim is the final-step eval (#8 claimed 3250 of 3275).

changes.label: Skeleton rebuilt on #12's script
changes.detail: F.rms_norm RMSNorm/QK-norm (gains now multiplied in activation dtype — numerically minor), num_trials loop with in-loop train_loader, 125→25-step eval cadence after 90%; seeding via KL_SOAP_SEED (default 1) and reset_parameters() before #8's init multipliers.

edge.parent_check: Declared parent #8 is right for the method, but the file is textually closest to #12 (222 vs 464 changed lines) because it was rebuilt on the updated baseline skeleton: docstring, F.rms_norm RMSNorm/QK-norm, dist.get_rank() data generator, num_trials loop with in-loop train_loader, 125→25-step eval cadence and per-interval step_avg all match #12. Nothing of #12's optimizer, init or schedule is used. Carried over from #8: scale_invariant_update_ (condensed, same math), the ×1.25/×3.0/×1.5 multipliers on default reset_parameters() init with zeroed head and proj biases (not #12's Gaussian init with all biases zero), the four per-shape optimizer instances, lr 0.018, the 1.0/0.4 cooldown split and aux AdamW. Rebuilt: the hidden optimizer (KLSOAPH) and explicit seeding.
edge.noise: Skeleton plumbing from #12 (log format, num_trials loop, dense final evals, step_avg), seeding, reset_parameters(), and storing group['cooldown_frac'] instead of schedule_type.

techniques.note: Adam (β1 .95, β2 .9, eps 1e-8) in KL-Shampoo eigenbasis; shampoo β .9; QR refresh every step
all 72 block matrices pinned to init ‖W‖_F; step lr·‖W‖_F then renormalize; no wd
default init × attn.proj 1.25, mlp.proj 3.0, mlp.fc 1.5; LM head + proj biases zero
hidden: linear to 0 over 3125 steps (frac 1.0); aux: flat, then last 40%
AdamW embed 0.3 / head 1/320 / 1-D 0.01, betas (0.8, 0.95), eps 1e-10, wd 0

hparams.schedule.kind: linear decay; hidden from step 0, aux after 60%
hparams.hyperball.radius: per-matrix ‖W‖_F at init (expected ≈16 q/k/v, 20 attn.proj, 48 mlp.fc & mlp.proj)
hparams.init.proj: LM head proj.weight = 0; block proj weights non-zero

mechanisms.name: KL-SOAP (SOAP in a KL-Shampoo eigenbasis)
mechanisms.explain: Each matrix keeps two factor matrices GG_L, GG_R, their eigenbases Q_L, Q_R and per-direction eigenvalue EMAs. The factors are updated KL-Shampoo style — each side's gradient covariance is whitened by the other side's current inverse, Q diag(λ⁻¹) Qᵀ — and the bases are tracked by one power-iteration + QR per step. The actual step is SOAP-like (Adam moments of the rotated gradient, divided elementwise and rotated back) and is fed to the hyperball update; the eigenvalue estimates only shape the factors, not the step.

caveats: No README; the code's printed config (beta1 .95, beta2 .9, shampoo_beta .9, lr .018, pf 1) matches the table. The result folder's sweep summary shows the same setup with beta1 = 0.9 failing (mean 3.28294 vs 3.27800 at 3125 steps), so beta1 = 0.95 matters. The missing bias correction only rescales the update uniformly and is cancelled by the hyperball normalization (up to eps).
